title: Employment Situation (Jan 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, the annual benchmark-revision edition and the most amplified equity payroll session of the twelve months
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th). THE RULE WAS RE-IMPLEMENTED AND RE-VALIDATED FROM SCRATCH BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal: 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For January 2027 data the reference week is Sun 2027-01-10 to Sat 2027-01-16, and the third Friday after 01-16 is 2027-02-05. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov 403s this runner: /schedule/news_release/2027_sched.htm, /schedule/news_release/empsit.htm, /schedule/home.htm and /bls/news-release/empsit.htm all returned HTTP 403 to curl under a browser user-agent on 2026-09-09, recorded in this event's probe-ref.blocked, and BLS has published no 2027 schedule at all. 2027-02-05 is an ordinary full NYSE session with no holiday within a week of it (Presidents Day is 2027-02-15), so the rule's one documented failure mode -- a derived Friday landing on a closed session -- cannot fire here. MEASURED THIS SESSION: that failure mode fires on 24 of 404 rule-emitted dates 1993-2026, and on exactly one date in the whole 2026-10 .. 2028-01 forward window, 2027-01-01 (the December 2026 reference month) -- the print immediately BEFORE this one, whose 2027-01-08 slip is a sibling lane's inference and not this lane's arithmetic. A derived date is not a published one
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09), superseding proposals/jobs-2027-02-05.from-treasury-refunding-2027-02-03.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. THE PROPOSAL'S FLAGGED-BUT-UNVERIFIED CHARACTERISATION IS THE HEADLINE, AND IT WAS MEASURED HERE RATHER THAN CARRIED. The proposal noted that the January edition normally carries the CES annual benchmark revision and updated household-survey population controls, and honestly labelled that CARRIED, NOT VERIFIED. bls.gov still 403s every route, so the mechanism remains unsourced -- but the market-side consequence is now measured on Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted daily bars, 1993-2026, over SPY/QQQ/TLT/IEF/SHY/LQD/AGG/HYG/^VIX (380 usable payroll sessions, 34 of them February-released). THE FEBRUARY-RELEASED PAYROLL IS THE MOST AMPLIFIED EQUITY PAYROLL SESSION OF THE TWELVE MONTHS: SPY payroll-day amplification (payroll-session median absolute move over the SAME month's non-payroll median, which divides the month's own baseline out) is 1.94x, RANK 1 OF 12 against a 1.28x median month, and HYG is 1.70x, also RANK 1 OF 12. Print-day absolute move is 1.73x every other payroll (p=0.0138, n=34/346), HYG 1.82x (p=0.0322); against the ten NEAREST OTHER FEBRUARY SESSIONS -- the tightest control available -- SPY is 1.78x (p=0.0015) and QQQ 1.56x (p=0.0275). Leave-one-out keeps SPY significant in 34 of 34 year-drops (worst p=0.0197) and all three eras agree in sign (<=2002 1.70x, 2003-2009 1.89x, 2010-2026 1.54x) without any one reaching significance alone. RATES ARE ORDINARY, NOT AMPLIFIED AND NOT SUPPRESSED: TLT rank 7/12, IEF 7/12, SHY 7/12, LQD 8/12, ^VIX 7/12, print-day ratios 1.00x/0.89x/1.00x/0.86x/0.91x, every p >= 0.48. That is a FOURTH seasonal profile in this calendar's running series -- August swept TLT/IEF/AGG ranks 1/1/1, September was quiet everywhere, October was equity-side with rates DEAD LAST, February is equity-and-credit-amplified with rates simply average. IT IS A CENTER SHIFT, NOT A TAIL: February payrolls clear the all-payroll 95th-percentile absolute move 1 of 34 in SPY against 1.7 expected, the D+1 session is flat (1.04x, p=0.90), and forward 10-session realized vol is if anything LOWER (SPY 0.88x, p=0.31). A SIBLING'S POOLED NULL IS DECOMPOSED, NOT CONTRADICTED: jobs-2027-05-07 measured refunding-month payrolls at 0.96-1.09x an ordinary payroll Friday; that reproduces here at 1.07x (p=0.76) and is the average of a rank-1 February and three ordinary months -- February vs May/Aug/Nov is SPY 1.77x (p=0.027) while May/Aug/Nov vs the eight non-refunding months is 0.94x (p=0.74). The refunding-supply story stays refuted; what the pooled number hid is a calendar effect, not a supply effect. Corridor position: D-4 from ism-manufacturing-2027-02-01 (high) and boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-02-01, D-2 from ism-services-2027-02-03 (high) and treasury-refunding-2027-02-03, D+4 from eia-steo-2027-02-09, D+9 after fomc-2027-01-27 (FED: primary, HTTP 200 2026-09-09) and D+14 from opex-2027-02-19 -- an ORDINARY 10-session runway, the plain-vanilla counterpart to jobs-2027-10-08's five. Impact high matches every other jobs-* entry on this calendar; symbols [] matches them too. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
